question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "starting".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, there are two subjects that are **supermarkets and grocers.**
 
• The verb **"be"** and the verb "**-ing"** form combine to generate the **continuous tense**.
 
• We can see there is **"are"** as a **verb** in the sentence.
 
• So the **present continuous** form of verb should be used after **"are"**.

The final sentence will be **But supermarkets and grocers are starting__ to sit up and take notice.**
